description: Backend auth foundation: migration 011, env keys, scrypt hashing, HMAC-JWT token service, extended user/session/token/subject repositories, authService lifecycle, /auth router+controller, authorization + CSRF middleware wired into createApp, and the create-admin CLI. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except that both depend on this one (shared middleware, token service, repositories, and the SEND_EMAIL enqueue path consumed by FEAT-002). Unit-tested with injected fake repositories (InMemoryDatabase cannot run the new SQL).
steps: Add backend/db/migrations/011_auth_step2.sql: ALTER TABLE app_user ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS must_change_password BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auth_session_user ON auth_session(user_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_password_token_user ON password_token(user_id). Do NOT recreate tables from 004/005.

Extend backend/src/config/env.js with jwtAccessTtlSec(900), jwtRefreshTtlSec(604800), cookieSecure(readBoolean COOKIE_SECURE,false), cookieSameSite('Lax'), smtpFrom, smtpSecure(readBoolean,false), passwordSetTtlHours(72), passwordResetTtlMinutes(30), loginMaxFailures(5), loginWindowMinutes(15), loginLockMinutes(15) following the existing process.env||default / readBoolean pattern; keep jwtSecret. Mirror the new keys as commented lines in <WT>\.env.example.

Create backend/src/auth/passwordHasher.js (crypto scrypt: hash, verify timing-safe, assertStrong>=8) and backend/src/auth/tokenService.js (HMAC-SHA256 sign/verify with {sub,role,type,iat,exp,jti}; randomToken/sha256 helpers) with the JWT-choice rationale comment from context.json decisions.

Extend backend/src/repositories/appUserRepository.js: add findByEmailOrCode(identifier), update(id,patch) with a column whitelist, list({role}), countByRole(role); keep existing methods. Add backend/src/repositories/authSessionRepository.js (create, findActiveByHash, revoke, revokeAllForUser) and backend/src/repositories/passwordTokenRepository.js (create, findActiveByHash(hash,purpose), markUsed, invalidateActiveForUser(userId,purpose)). Extend backend/src/repositories/subjectRepository.js with update(id,patch), remove(id), setLecturers(subjectId,lecturerIds) (replace-set in a transaction via db.withTransaction), listSubjectIdsForLecturer(lecturerId).

Create backend/src/services/authService.js implementing login (email OR code lookup; lockout: >=5 failures within 15 min sets locked_until now+15min; reset counters + set last_login_at + mint access/refresh + store sha256(refresh) in auth_session on success), refresh (verify, rotate: revoke old + create new), logout (revoke by hash, idempotent), me (safe user, no password_hash), forgotPassword (enumeration-safe identical response; create single-use RESET token 30min; enqueue SEND_EMAIL), resetPassword (validate active RESET token, assertStrong, set hash, markUsed, revokeAllForUser), setPassword (purpose SET 72h, clear must_change_password), changePassword (verify current, set new, revoke other sessions). Inject repositories, passwordHasher, tokenService, backgroundJobRepository, clock, env.

Create backend/src/middleware/auth.js createAuthMiddleware({tokenService,env,appUserRepository}) exposing requireAuth (read access cookie -> req.user, 401), requireRole(...roles) (403), requireSubjectScope({param,subjectRepository}) (ADMIN bypass; LECTURER must be assigned; else 403). Create backend/src/middleware/csrf.js verifyOrigin(allowedOrigins) rejecting non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requests whose Origin is absent/not allowed (derive allowed from env.appBaseUrl).

Create backend/src/controllers/authController.js (login/logout/refresh/me/forgot-password/reset-password/set-password/password handlers; set/clear access+refresh cookies with httpOnly:true, secure:env.cookieSecure, sameSite:env.cookieSameSite, path:'/') and backend/src/routes/authRoutes.js createAuthRouter(controller,{requireAuth}) with /me and PUT /password requiring auth.

Wire into backend/src/app.js: app.use(cookieParser()) after express.json(), app.use(verifyOrigin(...)), build auth repos/service/controller/middleware with overrides.* escape hatches, app.use('/auth', createAuthRouter(...)), and expose the middleware factory on the returned app/context so FEAT-002 can reuse requireAuth/requireRole. Add cookie-parser@1.4.7 to backend/package.json dependencies.

Create backend/src/cli/createAdmin.js: parse --code --email --full-name --password (fallback to readline prompts), assertStrong, hash, insert ADMIN via AppUserRepository.create against createDatabase(env) (needs DB_MOCK_MODE=false + DATABASE_URL); refuse a 2nd ADMIN unless --force; support --help with no DB write. Add "create-admin":"node src/cli/createAdmin.js" to backend/package.json scripts.

Add unit tests (node:test, *Service.test.js) using injected fakes: backend/test/passwordHasherService.test.js, tokenServiceService.test.js, authService.test.js (lockout, refresh rotation, enumeration-safe forgot, single-use reset reuse rejected), authMiddlewareService.test.js (requireRole/requireSubjectScope allow+deny).

Run cd <WT>\backend; npm install (installs cookie-parser@1.4.7); npm test and fix until green. Commit locally on branch feat/e2e-step2-auth. Record anything FEAT-002/003 need (exact token cookie names, middleware export shape, enqueue payload contract) in this file's findings.

findings:
Implemented and verified. npm test = 60/60 unit tests pass (incl. passwordHasher, tokenService, authService, authMiddleware suites). npm run test:e2e exits 0 offline (2 Postgres suites self-skip, 74 passed). node src/cli/createAdmin.js --help exits 0 with no DB access. mock-database.json untouched.

== Contracts for FEAT-002/003 ==

COOKIE NAMES (single source of truth: backend/src/auth/cookieNames.js): access cookie = 'aives_access', refresh cookie = 'aives_refresh'. Both set httpOnly:true, secure:env.cookieSecure, sameSite:env.cookieSameSite, path:'/'. Access maxAge = jwtAccessTtlSec*1000 (900s default), refresh maxAge = jwtRefreshTtlSec*1000 (7d default). Require { ACCESS_COOKIE, REFRESH_COOKIE } from '../auth/cookieNames' rather than hardcoding.

MIDDLEWARE EXPORT SHAPE: createAuthMiddleware({tokenService,env,appUserRepository}) (backend/src/middleware/auth.js) returns { requireAuth, requireRole, requireSubjectScope }. requireAuth sets BOTH req.user={id,role} and req.auth={userId,role,jti}. requireRole(...roles) accepts spread or array (flattened), 403 on mismatch. requireSubjectScope({param='subjectId', subjectRepository}) -> ADMIN bypass, LECTURER must appear in subjectRepository.listSubjectIdsForLecturer(req.user.id) for Number(req.params[param]), else 403. requireAuth also accepts an 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header as a fallback to the access cookie. The built middleware is reusable off the returned app as app.authMiddleware, and the full wiring is on app.authContext {authService,authController,authMiddleware,tokenService,appUserRepository,authSessionRepository,passwordTokenRepository,subjectRepository,backgroundJobRepository}. createApp also accepts overrides.* escape hatches for every auth repo/service/controller/middleware for injection in tests.

SEND_EMAIL ENQUEUE PAYLOAD CONTRACT (authService._enqueuePasswordEmail -> backgroundJobRepository.enqueue('SEND_EMAIL', payload)): payload = { to: <user.email>, template: 'SET_PASSWORD' | 'RESET_PASSWORD', subject: <string>, variables: { fullName: <string|null>, link: <appBaseUrl>/set-password?token=<raw> OR <appBaseUrl>/reset-password?token=<raw>, purpose: 'SET' | 'RESET' } }. The raw token is only ever present in the email link; the DB stores sha256(raw) in password_token.token_hash. FEAT-002's real SEND_EMAIL handler (currently a no-op stub in src/jobs/handlers.js) must read these fields and THROW on failure to trigger queue retry. Suggested env for the mailer: smtpHost/smtpPort/smtpUser/smtpFrom/smtpSecure (all added to env.js in this FEAT).

AUTH ENDPOINT SHAPES (router mounted at /auth, backend/src/routes/authRoutes.js):
- POST /auth/login  body {identifier|email|code, password} -> 200 {user} + sets auth cookies. 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, 423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED (>=env.loginMaxFailures failures in env.loginWindowMinutes locks for env.loginLockMinutes).
- POST /auth/refresh  reads aives_refresh cookie -> 200 {user}, ROTATES (revokes old session row keyed by sha256(refresh), issues new pair). 401 when session missing/revoked/expired.
- POST /auth/logout  reads aives_refresh cookie -> 204, clears cookies, idempotent.
- GET  /auth/me  requireAuth -> 200 {user}.
- POST /auth/forgot-password  body {identifier|email|code} -> 200 {ok:true} ALWAYS (enumeration-safe; only enqueues SEND_EMAIL + creates single-use RESET token valid env.passwordResetTtlMinutes when user exists).
- POST /auth/reset-password  body {token, password} -> 200 {ok:true}; consumes single-use RESET token, assertStrong(>=8), revokes all sessions. 400 INVALID_TOKEN on bad/expired/used token.
- POST /auth/set-password  body {token, password} -> 200 {ok:true}; SET token valid env.passwordSetTtlHours, clears must_change_password.
- PUT  /auth/password  requireAuth  body {currentPassword, newPassword} -> 200 {ok:true}; verifies current, revokes other sessions (keeps caller's current refresh session).

SAFE USER SHAPE (authService.toSafeUser, exported): { id, code, email, fullName, role, status, mustChangePassword, lastLoginAt } — never includes password_hash.

TOKEN SERVICE: TokenService (backend/src/auth/tokenService.js) HMAC-SHA256 JWS; sign/signAccess/signRefresh return {token,payload}; verify(token,{type}) throws 401 on bad sig/expiry/type. Module also exports sha256(value) and randomToken(bytes). createApp falls back to a dev placeholder secret only when env.jwtSecret is empty (mock/test); real deploys set JWT_SECRET.

MIGRATION 011 (011_auth_step2.sql): added app_user.must_change_password BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false and app_user.updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); indexes idx_auth_session_user, idx_password_token_user. appUserRepository.update() now bumps updated_at automatically and whitelists must_change_password + profile columns.

CSRF: verifyOrigin(allowedOrigins) (backend/src/middleware/csrf.js) is mounted globally from [env.appBaseUrl]; rejects non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS with absent/mismatched Origin (403 FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN). When no allowed origins are configured (test harness testEnv has no appBaseUrl) the check is a no-op so supertest suites keep passing. Browser clients MUST send credentials and the Origin header will be present automatically.
